changelog.en: 1. Optimize the electrical differences in the soil.\n2. Remove the echo mode.

Implement install code compatibility with normal network joining, transparent to users
 Fix stack overflow issue + watchdog reset
 Register temperature attribute table and initialize
 Negative temperature two's complement correction: ~raw & 0x0FFF → ((~raw)+1) & 0x0FFF
 Fix temperature parameter type
 Adjust temperature upper limit clamping: >=10000→9999 changed to >12500→12500
 Complete soil moisture cluster attribute registration table
 Complete auto-binding on network join for soil moisture cluster (0x0408)
 SDK layer: restore startup partition after OTA abort, clean up OTA context
 Temperature cluster, humidity cluster, and power cluster do not report at application layer after config report, SDK reports instead
 Temperature/humidity report prohibition configuration: when maxInterval=0xFFFF, disable reporting at both application layer and SDK, when minInterval=0xFFFF and maxInterval=0x0000, restore SDK reporting (temperature: minInterval=28, maxInterval=3600, change=50; humidity: minInterval=14, maxInterval=3600, change=200;)
 Power report prohibition configuration same as above, when restoring reporting, default minimum interval is once per hour, maximum 12h, report on 5% drop (pwr_minInterval=3600, Pwr_maxInterval=43200, Pwr_reportChange=10;)

wakeInstruction.en: Manual triggering devices. Once the status is synchronized on the Homey App, it indicates that the sleep mode has been exited.
